name: registry 5xx
regex: (unexpected status.*|status code[:= ]*|HTTP(/[0-9.]+)?[[:space:]]+)5[0-9]{2}([^0-9]|$)|500 Internal Server Error|502 Bad Gateway|503 Service Unavailable|504 Gateway Timeout

name: network timeout or reset
regex: i/o timeout|TLS handshake timeout|connection reset by peer|dial tcp.*connection refused|(: |unexpected )EOF([[:space:]]|$)|temporary failure in name resolution|Client.Timeout exceeded

name: auth, tag or configuration error
regex: unauthorized|authentication required|denied|manifest unknown|name unknown|no matching manifest|not found|certificate|invalid reference|no such service|no space left|(unexpected status.*|status code[:= ]*|HTTP(/[0-9.]+)?[[:space:]]+)4[0-9]{2}([^0-9]|$)
